item.title: Kouri Richins, who wrote children's book about grief, found guilty of murder
item.description: Kouri Richins, the Utah woman who wrote a children's book on dealing with grief after the 2022 death of her husband, was convicted Monday of murdering him.

item.title: Randolph County School System agrees to close Uwharrie Ridge 6-12
item.description: RANDOLPH COUNTY, N.C. (WGHP) -- The Randolph County School System made the decision on Monday night to close Uwharrie Ridge 6-12.
